text:
sanjay: Observing a perf regression on long-context RLHF workloads after the recent continuous-batch merge change. p95 token latency jumped from ~45ms -> ~130ms; memory growth on the server process ~+1.1GB/hour under steady traffic. Repro script: `./tools/loadtest --profile rl-longctx --qps 20`. Anyone seen this before?

elaine: ugh, that aligns w/ the kvcache metrics i pulled. kv.fragmentation.ratio up ~2x, evict.count doubled, and there are lots of tiny pages being churned. suspecting merge is causing cross-session reuse churn + late pinning.

ben: Can you paste the flamegraph snapshot? also which merge heuristic is enabled? we shipped tail-merge + allow-split=false last week.

sanjay: Flamegraph (sampled from perf) - hotspots: 
```
0. perf_worker                           35.6%
  - kv_cache::page_in                    18.2%
  - contbatch::merge_batches            9.8%
  - kv_cache::pin_slot                   5.6%
  - kernel_dispatch                      1.2%
```
Also timeline shows many small page_in ops interleaved with merge work. Merge size distribution shifted: median merge size up from 3 -> 7 requests.

perf-ci-bot: A/B run results: baseline(earlier): p95=48ms, mem=2.2GB. merged-change: p95=129ms, mem=3.3GB. delta: +81ms, +1.1GB. test harness: rl-longctx, seq_len=4096, client_count=40.

mike: that smells like head-of-line blocking inside the KV page pin path. If merging bundles requests from sessions with disjoint contexts, one request may block others waiting for KV pins or page_in. Did we change pin timing?

elaine: yes, the merge patch deferred slot pins until merge completion to reduce unnecessary pins for ephemeral batches. Idea was good for short-context, but for long-context it means the merged batch pins many slots at once -> page_in storm and eviction churn. We effectively switched from early-pin-per-request -> bulk-pin-after-merge.

ben: okay. so two interacting factors: (1) bulk pining causes large synchronous page_in fanout, (2) merge increases effective working set per worker, pushing eviction/fragmentation. That explains memory growth + tiny page allocations.

carol: can we instrument the pin window and add a metric `kv.pin.bulk.window_ms` and `kv.pin.batch_size`? want to know typical delay between first request arrival and the actual pin.

elaine: i've added a quick patch locally: emit `kv.pin.delay_ms` per merge and `merge.shared_prefix_frac` (how similar the sessions are). On the repro rig, merge.shared_prefix_frac median was 0.05 -> very low overlap.

ben: low overlap + bulk pin is the smoking gun. Proposed mitigations:
- gated-merge: refuse to merge batches whose shared_prefix_frac < X (e.g., 0.2)
- early-pin hybrid: pin per-request on arrival for slots likely to be reused within T ms, otherwise bulk pin for high-overlap merges
- limit-merge-by-kvfootprint: cap merge size when estimated resulting kvcache working set > threshold

sanjay: i prefer quick rollback to avoid customer impact. We should feature-flag gated-merge off and revert to previous behavior (early pin). But also want an experiment implementing the gated heuristic for better long-term perf.

deploy-bot: starting canary rollback to 2026-03-10-build-72 on inference-prod-us-east-1 in 3m.

perf-ci-bot: side-by-side microbenchmark after toggling feature flag 'merge.defer_pin=false': p95=52ms, mem=2.3GB. Looks much closer to baseline.

mike: for a longer-term fix, i suggest a heuristic that computes an "overlap score" between candidate requests using prefix/key fingerprinting: fast 64-bit Bloom-ish fingerprint per request representing KV keys touched so far; overlap score = Jaccard estimate. If overlap < threshold, do not merge or keep merge shallow. Also prefer LIFO tail-merge instead of FIFO head-merge to avoid blocking hot sessions.

elaine: implemented prototype of the fingerprint in `runtime::kv::fingerprint` — cheap 16-byte mask. quick results: with overlap gating at 0.18, merge sizes drop on longctx workload from median 7 -> 3, evict.count drops ~40%, p95 improves back to ~55ms.

ben: nice. we should also add adaptive windowing: when we see page_in_rate spike, lower merge_max_size and reduce merge.delay_ms. Add circuit-breaker: if kv.page_in.latency > 50ms for > N sec, fallback to per-request pinning.

carol: logging patch and experiment plan: 1) rollback immediate (in flight), 2) enable metric rollout (kv.pin.delay_ms, merge.shared_prefix_frac), 3) run overlap-gating A/B for two days on rl-longctx group, 4) if stable, ship voting to prod with feature flag.

sanjay: agreed. also add a nightly job to sweep kvcache fragmentation metrics and alert if fragmentation.ratio > 1.5 for > 10m. That would have flagged this earlier.

mike: small implementation note: don't rely on exact key sets from model runtime because tokenization boundaries differ slightly per request. fingerprint should hash KV slot ids (embedding shards + position ranges). That makes overlap estimation robust to minor token differences.

elaine: putting up a draft PR with gated-merge flag + fingerprint estimator + metrics (WIP). link: https://git.redwood/infra/merge-heuristics/pull/342 (internal).

ben: once PR lands, let's run perf profile with `perf record -g` to validate hotspots shrink; specifically watch `kv_cache::page_in` and `contbatch::merge_batches`. If merge hotspots drop and kernel dispatch rises proportionally, that's a good sign we moved work to expected places.

perf-ci-bot: created perf job: merge-heuristics/overlap-gate-A (rl-longctx). queued. ETA 45m.

carol: plan for changelog and postmortem: short note about regression cause = deferred pin + high merge overlap with low shared prefixes -> page_in storm + fragmentation. action items: rollback, add metrics, implement overlap gating, add circuit-breaker. assign owners: elaine (implement/gate), ben (perf validation), carol (monitoring + postmortem), sanjay (rollout coordination).

sanjay: thanks everyone — i'll watch the rollback and the perf job. please keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollback to 2026-03-10-build-72 started. will report status.

deploy-bot: rollback completed on inference-prod-us-east-1. health checks green.

perf-ci-bot: A run done for overlap-gate-A (small sample): gated variant shows p95=59ms, mem=2.4GB, evict.count -35% vs merged-change.

elaine: will push PR to staging and wire up circuit-breaker test. posting logs once available.

ben: great thread. follow-ups: add unit test for fingerprint collision bounds and a stress test for merge decisions w/ synthetic key distributions.

mike: also file a perf-regression ticket linking to these metrics + PR ids so we keep a trace.

sanjay: filed PERF-897 (regression, KV page-in storm). linking PR/monitoring.

carol: closing loop: postmortem draft expected tomorrow. will include timeline, root cause, metrics graphs.

sanjay: nice work.
